questions.q: Choose the correct form of verb: She _____ to school every day.
questions.explanation: Simple Present Tense with third-person singular (She) takes 'goes'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: They _____ football since morning.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous Tense is used for action started in past and continuing ('since morning').
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: He is _____ honest man.
questions.explanation: The word 'honest' begins with a vowel sound (o-nest), so 'an' is used.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: _____ Ganges is a sacred river.
questions.explanation: 'The' is mandatory before names of rivers.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct Passive Voice of: 'She sings a song.'
options: A song was sung by her.
A song is sung by her.
A song is being sung by her.
A song has been sung by her.
questions.explanation: Simple Present active (sings) changes to 'is + V3 (sung)' in passive.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct Passive Voice of: 'They built a house.'
options: A house is built by them.
A house was built by them.
questions.explanation: Simple Past active (built) changes to 'was + V3 (built)' in passive.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct Active Voice of: 'The car was repaired by John.'
questions.explanation: 'was repaired' in passive corresponds to Simple Past 'repaired' in active.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: Water _____ at 100 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation: Universal truths and scientific facts take Simple Present Tense.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: Mount Everest is _____ highest peak in the world.
questions.explanation: Superlative adjectives (highest) require the definite article 'the'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct form: If it rains, we _____ at home.
questions.explanation: First conditional: 'If + Simple Present', then 'Simple Future (shall/will stay)'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: She is fond _____ music.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'fond' takes the fixed preposition 'of'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He died _____ cholera.
questions.explanation: Die + 'of' is used when someone dies of a specific disease.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: Look _____ the blackboard.
questions.explanation: The verb 'look' takes 'at' when directing sight.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He jumped _____ the river.
questions.explanation: 'into' indicates movement from outside to inside.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct Indirect Speech of: He said, 'I am busy.'
options: He said that I am busy.
He says that he was busy.
He said that he was busy.
questions.explanation: Present continuous/simple 'am' changes to past 'was' in reported speech.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct Indirect Speech of: She said to me, 'What are you doing?'
options: She asked me what I was doing.
She told me what I am doing.
She asked me what was I doing.
She asked me that what I was doing.
questions.explanation: Interrogative sentences change to 'asked' and word order becomes assertive.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Bread and butter _____ his wholesome food.
questions.explanation: When two singular nouns together express a single idea, a singular verb ('is') is used.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Neither he nor his friends _____ present.
questions.explanation: With 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject ('his friends' = plural -> were).
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Each of the boys _____ a prize.
questions.explanation: 'Each of' takes a singular verb ('has').
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: The meeting will start _____ 10 AM.
questions.explanation: Exact clock times take the preposition 'at'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Translate into English: 'वह कल पटना जाएगा।'
options: He will go to Patna tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Simple Future Tense translation for 'जाएगा' is 'will go'.

options: The sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: Universal truth translation requires Simple Present Tense.

questions.q: Translate into English: 'मैं दो घंटे से पढ़ रहा हूँ।'
options: I had read for two hours.
I have been reading for two hours.
I am reading since two hours.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous translation with duration ('for two hours').
